title: Coming out as a Legally Blonde stan… #Broadway #TheCottage #newplay #...
transcript: Hello 👋🏻  I'm Ben and this weekend I saw The Cottage, and I really wanna talk about it! So for those that don't know, The Cottage is a new play on Broadway. It's a farcical seggs comedy and it has an all-star cast including Laura Bell Bundy, Lily Cooper, Eric McCormick, Dana Steingold, Alex Moffat from SNL, just a really stacked cast! And part of the reason why I really wanna talk about this one is because we don't really get plays like this anymore. I feel like all the new plays we get nowadays are mostly like prestige pieces. They’re big, important works of theater that are saying something super profound, and this is just a good old fashioned comedy that's just here to make you laugh and give you a good time at the theater. And there really is something so classic feeling about this play. Like it feels like a play that could have been written 40/50 years ago but it's not and that's kinda cool! And that's not to say that it doesn't appeal to modern audiences, or modern sensibilities. I think that there's a lot that the show does very smartly to appeal to more modern sensibilities than maybe a show like this would have 40/50 years ago, because while I found Act 1 to be fairly formulaic in its plot, I definitely thought Act 2 made a lot of really interesting decisions that I did not expect it to that made the play feel fresh and new. And of course I absolutely have to shout out the cast once again, who're giving incredible performances across the board. Laura Bell Bundy especially! I'm a little biased, because I love Legally Blonde, and I love her in Legally Blonde, but it was very cool to see her live and I thought she did a great job essentially leading the show. It's very much an ensemble piece, but if you had to name a lead it would be her and I think that she does a really, really good job as that central character. However another star of the show is definitely the set, which is so cool and so detailed. I was actually invited along to see the show by my good friend Ashley Huffford (If you're not following her, you probably already are, but if you're not go follow her she's great!) She invited me as her plus one to this Influencer Night that they were doing and afterwards we got to go up on stage and explore the set and take photos and that was so cool to get to see all of the details up close. And there were so many things that I noticed when I was exploring up close that I wasn't able to see from my seat, so that was really cool! But yeah, all in all just a really fun night at the theatre, and if you're looking for a good comedy play I would definitely recommend The Cottage. I think it's really funny, the cast is incredible, the set is incredible, and I think you'll have a good time!
reasoning: Ben clearly recommends The Cottage as a fun comedy with praise for the cast, set, and overall entertainment value, though he notes Act 1 is formulaic.
